name: Hazards
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Bind heat, burning, falling, breathing/suffocation and selected environmental exposure to actual positions, altitude, surfaces, time and defenses. Distinguish an effect appearing from creature movement, entry, start/end turns and elapsed ticks. Water Walk grants traversal without heat immunity; source-specific descent/landing and breathing exceptions remain attached.

blockers: Ashvale heat is campaign-authored 1d4 at five feet, not generic SRD lava damage. Storm/rockslide/cave-in events remain custom checks, not a whole weather or avalanche simulation. No general weather, underwater route, air volume or climate can be inferred from terrain names.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.

source_parameters.authority: SRD 5.2.1 pp.178,182,189; retain source and spell exceptions
source_parameters.falling: 1d6 Bludgeoning per 10 feet fallen, maximum 20d6; Prone on landing unless no damage taken. Falling into water/liquid allows Reaction DC15 STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics), success halves resulting fall damage.
source_parameters.suffocation: Hold breath minutes = 1 + CON modifier, minimum 30 seconds. Out of breath or choking gains 1 Exhaustion at end of each turn. Breathing again removes all Exhaustion gained from suffocation, not unrelated Exhaustion.
source_parameters.flight_loss: Incapacitated, Prone or Fly Speed 0 causes fall unless hovering; specific spell descent rules remain exceptions.
source_parameters.custom_lava: Ashvale cell [3,-1], authored 1d4 heat with five-foot reach; not an SRD generic lava formula.
